( IB) 
PWD COLONY LUMDING ROAD DIPHU KARBI ANGLONG ASSAM-782460.

Advocate for : MR F KHAN  Page   Advocate for : SC REVENUE appearing for THE STATE OF ASSAM AND 6 ORS.
 BEFORE
HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MANISH CHOUDHURY

ORDER Date : 09.02.2024 Heard Mr. J. Sheqi, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. N. Bordoloi, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department; Mr. I. Borthakur, learned Standing Counsel, Forest &
Environment Department; Ms. R. Bora, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL; and Mr. J. Chutia,
learned Standing Counsel, KAAC; and Mr. C. Baruah, learned Standing Counsel, NHAI.

2. It is submitted by Mr. Chutia, learned Standing Counsel, KAAC and Ms. Bora, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL that the parcels of land in respect of which the petitioners are claiming compensation, fall under Longnit District Council Reserve Forest [DCRF].

Mr. Chutia has further contended that Longnit District Council Reserve Forest has been declared by the respondent Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council [KAAC] in exercise of powers under Paragraph 3[b] of the 6th Schedule of the Constitution of India and as such, the petitioners cannot claim title/ownership in respect of those parcels of land which fall within a reserved forest, declared by the respondent Council.
3. Mr. Borthakur, learned Standing Counsel, Environment & Forest Department shall obtain instructions [i] whether Longnit District Council Reserve Forest [DCRF] is a reserved forest declared by the State Government under the Assam Forest Regulation, 1891 or not; and [ii] if yes,
the relevant Notification issued under the provisions of the Assam Forest Regulation, 1891, the same Page No. 1/14 vs The State Of Assam And 11 Ors on 9 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134262215/
12 shall be brought on record by affidavit.
4.

Ms. Bora, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL has submitted that on the request of the State Government, the Central Government in exercise of powers conferred under Section 2 of the Forest Conservation Act, 1980 has permitted de-reservation of the forest areas and for use of forest land for non-forest purposes.
5.

Mr. Chutia and Mr. Borthakur have prayed for listing of the case on 04.03.2024 to enable them to file counter affidavits on behalf of the respondent KAAC authorities and the respondent Environment & Forest Department authorities.

6. List the cases accordingly on 04.03.2024.
JUDGE
